up: Retrieve IC50 values in nM for compounds tested against human acetylcholinesterase (target CHEMBL1914). Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, and docs. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', and target CHEMBL1914. Only include rows where canonical_smiles is not null and (pubmed_id is not null or doi is not null). Return: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, target_name, organism, and standard_value.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism, a.standard_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1914' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
